# Head timestamp fixtures (TY-03)

Test keys only: these bytes mean nothing outside tests. Generated by
`go test ./cmd/deedglass -run TestTimestampFixture -update-timestamps`, then pinned in
`../SHA256SUMS`.

| File | What it is |
|---|---|
| `stamped.tar.gz` | The 20-record test chain (org 2, test keys a and b) as an export bundle with `timestamps.json`: deed 20 timestamped by two fake RFC 3161 TSAs at 2026-10-20 09:30:00 UTC and registered with a fake transparency service |
| `cut.tar.gz` | The same chain cut after deed 17, exported again with no timestamps |
| `timestamps.json` | The bundle's `timestamps.json` on its own |
| `tsa-roots.pem` | The two fake TSAs' roots (`verify --tsa-roots`) |
| `scitt-key.jwk` | The fake service's P-256 key (`verify --scitt-key`) |

`deedglass verify stamped.tar.gz --keys ../deeds/keys/test-keys.json` passes and reports the head;
`deedglass verify cut.tar.gz --keys … --timestamps timestamps.json` fails with `chain_tail_missing`.
